The combination rule is a DECISION TABLE enumerating every combination of the five signals including all missing-data cases, written and hash-frozen with a timestamp BEFORE any direction data is retrieved, published as a deliverable in its own right alongside the verdicts. UNDETERMINED is the default and there is no silent third state. A typed `modality` enum on every candidate is a hard prerequisite with its own gate, since modality is currently only inferable from prose in candidates[].mechanism. validate.py gets a census metric -- the count of candidates asserting a direction with no genetic support -- required to be non-increasing, failing only on regression, not a blanket 34-of-35 gate.
final_success_criteria: The decision table exists as a file whose SHA-256 and timestamp are recorded in the ledger BEFORE the first direction retrieval runs, and a test recomputes the hash and fails if the table changed after that timestamp.

BIDIRECTIONAL FIXTURE: flipping a test candidate's modality from agonist to inhibitor flips its verdict from CONCORDANT to DISCORDANT. NULL FIXTURE: deleting any one contributing signal degrades that verdict to UNDETERMINED. Both must pass; neither is satisfiable by a stub.

SHEDDING FIXTURE: a synthetic pQTL annotated instrument_measures=shed_ectodomain with an unambiguous +1 sign yields UNDETERMINED, not CONCORDANT, and the emitted record carries PMIDs 28855301 and 36721205. A test asserts that no code path lets a shed_ectodomain instrument reach the verdict function.

The TREM2 allelic-series table contains at minimum rs75932628 with OR 2.92 (95% CI 2.09-4.09), P=3.42e-10, classification 'hypomorph', PMID 23150908, and the Guerreiro replication PMID 23150934, with every row carrying a PMID and the admission rule and denominator printed.

TREM2 colocalization records list the per-credible-set signs (+1, -1, 0) with their individual h4 and CLPP and an explicit not_determined verdict; no pooled or averaged sign appears anywhere in the dataset, asserted by a test that greps for an averaged sign field.
Every candidate carries a typed modality enum value; candidates whose modality cannot be determined from prose are recorded NOT_DETERMINED and are counted, not guessed.
No MR estimate appears anywhere in the deliverable.

revised.title: Instrument provenance and compartment reachability: record which biosample each genetic instrument came from, and gate extracellular agents against cytoplasmic targets -- expression demoted to a peripheral-exposure liability index with a genome-wide reference distribution
revised.changed_what:
Two of the four steps are withdrawn, the ordering is inverted, and one critic's central factual prediction is refuted with measurement.

(1) check_region_claim IS WITHDRAWN. Bulk GTEx has 13 brain regions, no hippocampal subfield and no cell-type resolution, and bulk TPM is a composition-weighted average. It cannot adjudicate 'CA1 pyramidal neurons'. Computing a tissue-level fold-change and letting it stand against a subcellular claim substitutes a number for missing evidence -- which is the failure mode this repository exists to prevent. The gate is gone.

(2) STEP 2 (MiGA/MetaBrain colocalization) IS WITHDRAWN AS A PROPOSAL and replaced by a one-day go/no-go spike that produces only a record: actual file sizes, genome build, and the access terms for each source including the EADB controlled-access component of Bellenguez 2022. Three critics independently said a week is a material underestimate for harmonising two consortia to a common build with consistent effect-allele orientation, and they are right; it is also the step most likely to be abandoned half-done, leaving instrument provenance for some targets and not others.

(3) THE COMPARTMENT GATE IS PROMOTED TO FIRST. The DMPK critic is right that I made expression the first question when it is the second. An extracellular peptide cannot engage GSK-3beta or Keap1 at any regional TPM, and the observation that 0/35 sequences carry a documented RMT shuttle motif settles reachability before expression is even relevant. A UniProt subcellular-location gate crossed with declared modality and route runs in minutes with no API budget and catches the mechanistically inverted candidates that expression never will.

(4) THE SPECIFICITY INDEX GETS A REAL DENOMINATOR, AND IT IS CHEAPER THAN THE CRITICS ASSUMED. Both critics called it an invented statistic with no reference distribution -- an ipTM-0.8 heuristic in different clothing. Correct. The fix they proposed (compute it for all protein-coding genes and express each target as a percentile) turns out to need one file, not a pipeline: I verified HTTP 200 and content-length 8,846,936 bytes for the GTEx v10 gene median TPM matrix (GTEx_Analysis_v10_RNASeQCv2.4.2_gene_median_tpm.gct.gz). An 8.8 MB download makes the genome-wide reference distribution an afternoon's work, so there is no excuse for a threshold pulled from air.
conceded: check_region_claim on bulk GTEx cannot test the claim it names. Withdrawn entirely.

The specificity index as brain-median / whole-body-median is an ad hoc ratio with no reference distribution, and TPM is compositional so cross-tissue ratios are confounded by library composition. Replaced with a named peripheral_exposure_index expressed as a percentile against the genome-wide empirical distribution, and framed solely as an on-target peripheral-toxicity liability for a systemically dosed agent, never as a refutation of a region claim.
Step 2 was materially understated at 'roughly a week' and skipped an access-terms question for the EADB component. Withdrawn and replaced by a go/no-go spike that produces a record and nothing else.

A null colocalization from an underpowered source is not 'no instrument available'. MiGA is 255 samples from 100 donors. Every colocalization result must carry QTL sample size and the minimum detectable PP4 at that n, so 'tested, not colocalized' and 'underpowered' are distinguishable Values.
Compartment reachability is cheaper and more decisive than expression for this catalogue, and should run first. Conceded and reordered.
A resolution field is needed on every expression Value, and any claim stated at finer resolution than its evidence must be recorded NOT_TESTABLE rather than failed.
My step-1 'seconds' timing claim needed re-verification -- the critic reported a GTEx v10 call not returning in 120 s. Their caution is warranted: I hit a worse failure mode below.
defended: The specific prediction that check_region_claim 'will fail TREM2 -- a myeloid-restricted gene with high spleen, blood and lung expression' -- a false positive on the only true positive -- is empirically false on GTEx v10. Measured this session across 54 tissues: TREM2's single highest tissue is Brain_Spinal_cord_cervical_c-1 at 48.42 TPM; Lung is rank 3 at 18.61; Brain_Hippocampus rank 7 at 9.85; Spleen rank 42 at 0.55; Whole_Blood rank 43 at 0.52. max-non-brain / max-brain = 0.38, so TREM2 sits comfortably on the CNS-enriched side and the predicted false positive does not occur. HOWEVER, I will not claim this as a clean win: 0.55 TPM in spleen is implausibly low for a myeloid-restricted receptor, which means GTEx bulk is a poor instrument for TREM2 rather than evidence that TREM2 is neuronal. The specific prediction fails; the critic's broader point -- that bulk tissue cannot resolve a myeloid gene -- is vindicated by the same numbers that refute it. That is why the region gate is withdrawn and the index is demoted to a peripheral-exposure liability rather than defended as a specificity measure.

The CHRFAM7A paralog flag on CHRNA7, which all reviewers endorsed and which I keep unchanged: it is a measurement-artifact caveat, not a biology result, and with the genome-wide reference distribution in place it becomes quantitative -- the confounded estimate can be shown against the distribution rather than merely annotated.

Instrument provenance (step 3) exactly as originally proposed. Two critics called it the strongest single check in the packet and neither asked for changes. It is nearly free -- the biosample and projectId already arrive in the same GraphQL response -- and it converts an invisible assumption into a checkable field.
revised.final_method:
Ordered by cost, cheapest and most decisive first.

STEP 1 -- check_compartment (hours, no API budget). Cross UniProt subcellular-location terms for each target against the candidate's typed modality and route. Fail extracellular-agent / cytoplasmic-target pairs before any GTEx call and before any structural compute. Record, as a separate Value, that 0/35 sequences carry a documented RMT shuttle motif, so 'no transport mechanism' is a stored finding rather than a remark.

STEP 2 -- instrument provenance (2-3 days, unchanged from the original step 3). Every DirectionOfEffect record from GENO-B stores otherStudyLocus.study.biosample.biosampleName and projectId as REQUIRED fields plus a cell_type_match verdict against the candidate's declared cell type. On today's data every TREM2 record returns MISMATCH: instrument is blood plasma or CD14+CD16- classical monocyte, claimed site is brain. This composes with GENO-B's instrument_measures rule -- a plasma instrument is both wrong-compartment and shed-ectodomain, and each fact is recorded independently.

STEP 3 -- peripheral_exposure_index with a real denominator (2-3 days). Download the GTEx v10 gene median TPM matrix once (8.8 MB, verified available), compute max-non-CNS-median / max-CNS-median for every protein-coding gene, store the empirical distribution as a provenanced data file, and express each target's value as a PERCENTILE against it. Framed and gated purely as an on-target peripheral-toxicity liability for a systemically dosed agent. Every expression Value carries a `resolution` field (tissue | region | cell_type | subcellular); any claim stated at finer resolution than its supporting evidence is recorded NOT_TESTABLE, never failed and never adjudicated by a coarser number. CHRNA7 Values carry the CHRFAM7A 15q13.3 paralog flag with reduced confidence.

STEP 4 -- cell-type claims deferred to a single-nucleus brain atlas, the only source that can address 'CA1 pyramidal neuron' or 'microglia'. Scoped but not costed here.

STEP 5 -- one-day spike, not a build: record actual file sizes, genome build and access terms for MiGA, MetaBrain and Bellenguez 2022 (including EADB controlled access), then re-estimate. No harmonisation pipeline is built unless the spike says a useful number of the 16 genes have a brain or microglial instrument at all.

IMPLEMENTATION TRAP, recorded because it fails silently: GTEx medianGeneExpression requires the exact versioned gencodeId. ENSG00000095970 unversioned and ENSG00000095970.15 both return an empty data array with HTTP 200 and no error; .17 works. NTRK2 is .18, not .19. The client must resolve every id through /reference/gene first and must treat a zero-row response as an error, not as absence of expression.
final_success_criteria: check_compartment runs before any network call and produces a per-candidate PASS / FAIL / NOT_DETERMINED with the UniProt subcellular-location term and accession cited; the extracellular-agent-versus-cytoplasmic-target candidates fail, and a fixture with a matched pair passes.

Every DirectionOfEffect record carries a non-empty instrument biosample and projectId and a cell_type_match verdict; all TREM2 records return MISMATCH against any brain cell-type claim; a record with a missing biosample raises rather than defaulting.

The genome-wide peripheral_exposure_index distribution is stored as a provenanced file with its GTEx release and gencode version, and every target's value is reported as a percentile against it -- no bare fold-change appears anywhere. A test asserts that no threshold constant in the code is a bare number rather than a stated quantile of that stored distribution.

TREM2's measured values are reproduced from the stored matrix: max tissue Brain_Spinal_cord_cervical_c-1 48.42 TPM, Lung 18.61, Spleen 0.55, Whole_Blood 0.52, and the record carries an explicit note that the low myeloid-tissue values indicate bulk GTEx is a weak instrument for this gene rather than evidence of neuronal restriction.

Every expression Value carries a resolution field; a candidate claim at cell-type or subcellular resolution against tissue-level evidence yields NOT_TESTABLE, and a fixture proves the coarser number cannot produce a PASS or FAIL for a finer claim.
The GTEx client raises on a zero-row HTTP 200 response, proven by a test using the unversioned ENSG00000095970 that currently returns an empty array.
CHRNA7 expression Values carry the CHRFAM7A paralog flag and are never reported as a bare TPM.

The step-5 spike produces a dated record of file sizes, builds and access terms for MiGA, MetaBrain and Bellenguez EADB, and an explicit go/no-go decision. No harmonisation code is written before that record exists.

refined.expert: DMPK / CNS drug delivery (PhD, 17 years industry; CNS peptides through preclinical)

revised.title: Junction-resolved MHC-II immunogenicity screen with a human self-proteome filter — WITHDRAWN
revised.changed_what: Withdrawn. Not because the reviewers demanded it — all three endorsed it, one at 5/5 value — but because a measurement I made this session while responding to them destroys the deliverable that distinguished the proposal. The idea's selling point was junction attribution: 'attribute every neo-epitope to the specific GGGGS join that created it'. Reviewers correctly noted GGGGS is rare (6/35 sequences; gg_linker_fraction() non-zero for exactly 1). I then checked the harder question they did not: is a motif-motif junction locatable at all? I aligned all 16 attributed motifs plus the 2 unattributed pastiche segments from data/dataset.json motif_provenance against each of the 23 unique standard-residue sequences by exact substring, greedy longest-first. Result: only 6 of 23 sequences are >=99.5% covered by attributed segments; 11 of 23 have ZERO coverage; and only 4 sequences carry any identifiable internal junction at all (HippoNrf-KeapDecoy-X3 2, MicroNrf2-AntiInflam-M2 2, CogBDNF-Mimic-04 2, MicroDual-Trem2-Nrf2-M5 1) — 7 junctions across the whole catalogue. The junctional-neo-epitope statistic, and the within-molecule junctional-vs-non-junctional control that two reviewers correctly identified as the only defensible number in the proposal, are computable for 4 of 23 molecules. That is not a finding about the design method; it is an anecdote. What would remain after removing the junction arm is a raw MHC-II binder count behind a DTU licence wait, and I accept the reviewers' verdict on that residue: uncalibrated, weakly related to clinical ADA, and mislabelled 'SELF'. Two reviewers also caught me mislabelling my own primary evidence — Attermann 2020 measures the elevated false-positive rate of NetMHCIIpan-3.2 trained on binding affinity, and I would have used 4.3's %Rank_EL, which is the EL/MS-trained output the paper endorses; that specific objection is answerable, but it does not rescue an uncomputable headline. Finally, my own stack ordering was wrong. I ranked immunogenicity first. Measured today: 0 of 35 candidates carry any documented RMT shuttle motif and only 4 of 35 fall inside any BBB-peptide predictor's applicability domain. Ranking the T-cell epitope load of molecules with no route to the compartment is precision applied at the wrong step.
conceded: Junction attribution — the distinguishing deliverable — is computable for 4 of 23 unique valid sequences, 7 junctions total; 11 of 23 sequences have zero attributed-motif coverage. This is worse than any reviewer alleged and I measured it myself.

The GGGGS premise was quantitatively overstated: 6/35 sequences contain GGGGS, 8/35 contain GGGS, and the repo's own gg_linker_fraction() returns non-zero for exactly 1 candidate (CogDual-TrkB-PAS-10, 0.15), not the 12 I implied elsewhere.
n_binders / n_strong_binders reported raw against no null is the identical error the panel condemns for bare ipTM. Three reviewers said this independently and all three are right.

'SELF' is the wrong label for 'this 9-mer occurs in UP000005640'. Tolerance is presentation- and expression-dependent, not proteome-membership-dependent; the field name asserts a claim the test cannot support.
A single positive epitope plus its scramble is not a validation gate. A scramble of an immunodominant epitope can itself bind.
Counts scale with allele-panel size and sequence length, so a 100-mer is guaranteed to look worse than a 26-mer.
I should have reported over 26 unique sequences (23 with standard residues only), not 35 candidate records — the 36-mer KWWKFLRRFWRRLKKYFEELWKKLAEKYFELLKKYG alone appears three times.
My stack ordering was wrong: for a 3-11 kDa polycationic amphipath with no delivery mechanism, membrane lysis and aggregate-driven T-independent ADA precede T-cell-dependent epitope load.
defended: The tooling feasibility claims were correct and I verified them again this session rather than letting them fall with the rest: DTU ships NetMHCIIpan-4.3k as a Darwin ARM64 package, and MixMHC2pred's README documents three platform executables including a macOS binary. The reviewer who doubted arm64 availability was wrong on the facts. This does not save the idea; the idea fails on the science, not the binaries.

The Attermann objection targets the wrong model. Attermann et al. 2020 (PMID 33010039) measures an elevated false-positive rate for NetMHCIIpan-3.2 trained on binding-affinity data; NetMHCIIpan-4.x is trained on eluted-ligand MS data via NNAlign_MA and %Rank_EL is that output. Using %Rank_EL as primary was already the discipline the paper recommends.

The underlying scientific framing remains correct and I do not disown it: T-cell-dependent immunogenicity is sequence-determined, needs no receptor, no MSA and no GPU, and is a real gap. If this catalogue is ever replaced by molecules with attributable architecture and a delivery route, this screen should be built. It is out of scope for these 35.
revised.final_method: No implementation. Disposition: (1) the proposal is retired from the queue with this rationale written to the provenance ledger, so the negative result — that the catalogue's junction structure is not reconstructible from its own motif_provenance for 19 of 23 sequences — is recorded rather than lost; (2) that coverage measurement is itself a genuine audit finding about data/dataset.json and should be filed against the corpus, not against DMPK: 11 of 23 unique sequences contain no segment attributable to any documented source, and the two EGF-like 'pastiche' segments have zero exact hits in 575,503 SwissProt entries per the repo's existing scan. The honest one-line summary is that most of these molecules are not concatenations of published motifs at all; they are unattributed sequence. That belongs in the README as a design finding.
final_success_criteria: A ledger entry records the withdrawal, the motif-coverage measurement (6/23 fully covered, 11/23 zero coverage, 7 identifiable junctions across 4 sequences), and the script that reproduces it.
No immunogenicity field is added to the schema and no MHC-II binary is installed, so the platform continues to report nothing where it knows nothing.
The coverage result is re-filed as a corpus-provenance finding for whoever owns data/dataset.json.

revised.title: Deterministic peptidase-susceptibility census and terminal audit, with a structural arm that refuses more often than it reports
revised.changed_what: Substantially rebuilt after two of my supporting facts were shown false and a third was falsified by my own computation. (1) My claim that the Boltz coordinates were discarded is WRONG. /tmp/cbc_boltz holds 22 complete boltz_results trees with input_model_0.cif, confidence JSON and plddt/pae npz — I listed and parsed them today. The day of recompute I budgeted is deleted; the work is a copy-and-hash into the repo, shared with META-1 and STRUCTBIO-IDEA-1 and implemented once. (2) My headline hazard claim — that proteolysis liberates free amyloidogenic Abeta16-35 — is FALSIFIED. I ran pyteomics complete digestion on both KLVFF-bearing candidates against six Expasy rule sets: no protease in the panel releases the intact 20-mer core. Trypsin cuts at K16 and K28 exactly as the medicinal chemist predicted and releases LVFFAEDVGSNK; Glu-C releases KLVFFAE; chymotrypsin, pepsin pH2.0, thermolysin and proteinase K release nothing containing KLVFF. He was right and I was asserting, not computing. The replacement statement is sharper than the original: the species released under Glu-C-like activity is KLVFFAE, the canonical minimal self-assembling Abeta fragment, and under trypsin-like activity is LVFFAEDVGSNK, which retains the LVFFA hydrophobic cluster. That is a computed fragment identity with a named release route, which is what the proposal should have said. (3) The panel is a proteomics digestion panel wearing a DMPK label — I wrote that criticism of myself and I accept it. pyteomics.parser.expasy_rules contains 35 rule sets and I enumerated them today: there is no neprilysin, no IDE, no ACE, no DPP-4. Rather than substitute a similar enzyme (the exact failure mode this repo exists to eliminate), the module now labels every output 'in vitro specificity rule match, Expasy rule set <name>', never 'stability' and never 'clearance', and states in the field note that the CNS/plasma peptidases that actually govern exposure are absent from the rule set. (4) Added the terminal audit the census cannot see, already computed: N-terminal residue, P2 identity, C-terminal residue, declared amidation. Measured — 2 of 35 carry a DPP-4-compatible P2 (BasalNgf-TrkA-B3 Glu-Pro, CogBDNF-Mimic-04 Ala-Pro); every other construct presents a free alpha-amino group with a non-P2 second residue. Four bits per molecule, exact, more predictive of exposure than the whole endoprotease count. (5) The structural arm is demoted from a deliverable to a conditional overlay with a pre-declared refusal rule, and rescoped from per-residue SASA/SSE labels to the contiguous-extended-exposed-segment requirement the Hubbard criterion actually states.
conceded: My evidence item E6 was false. 22 mmCIF trees exist in /tmp/cbc_boltz; I verified all 22 today. The 'budget a day of compute' line is withdrawn and the fix is persistence, not recompute.
The Abeta16-35 liberation claim was asserted, not computed, and is falsified by the computation. Trypsin and Glu-C both cut inside the core.
The protease panel is a laboratory reagent panel with no clearance interpretation. parser.cleave() returns a complete digest, which has no kinetic meaning and cannot answer 'which bond is cut first'.
Site counts are near-deterministic functions of composition and need a null; '215 trypsin-like sites' is a restatement of Lys+Arg content.

pyteomics, biotite and freesasa were absent from BOTH venvs when the reviewer checked — my 'verified installed this session' claim did not reproduce against repo state. I have now installed pyteomics 5.0.1 and biotite 1.7.1 into .venv312 (Python 3.12.14) and every number in this revision was produced there.

The structural arm collapses for most of the catalogue and I now have the numbers: of the 22 folded models, 9 have frac_below_70 = 1.000, 14 have frac_below_70 >= 0.5, and the median plddt_mean is 60.97. Defaulting every undetermined site to 'accessible' and printing a SASA with a footnote is a number with a caveat, which reads as a number.
Implementing Hubbard as a per-residue SASA/SSE label loses the contiguous-extended-segment length requirement that does the mechanistic work.
The linker-fraction success criterion was wrong: gg_linker_fraction() is non-zero for exactly 1 candidate, not 12.
Disulfide connectivity is undefined for 31 candidates, so any SASA from one Boltz-sampled topology is a property of that sample, not of the molecule.
Duplicate counting: the catalogue-level totals triple-count the 36-mer. Report over 23 unique standard-residue sequences.
defended: Keeping the sequence census is right and the reviewers who wanted it shipped first are right: it discriminates. AstroPafr-Block-A4 has zero sites where the polycationic 36-mer has 24 in 36 residues. That needs no structure and no model.

The no-half-life rule stays verbatim, unweakened. Five reviewers independently called it the best clause in the batch and one asked for it to be copied elsewhere; I have copied it into IDEA-3 for HC50.

I decline to substitute a MEROPS-derived NEP/IDE regex for the missing enzymes. No retrievable executable specificity rule set for those activities exists in a package I can install here, and reconstructing one from memory is precisely the failure being remediated. The honest output is a labelled in-vitro-rule census plus an explicit statement of what is missing, not a plausible-looking CNS panel.

One reviewer said the structural arm would 'degrade to the sequence census while appearing to add rigour' and used that to argue for dropping it. I keep it, because the refusal rule makes the degradation visible rather than hidden, and because the arm is not uniformly useless: the three candidates with frac_below_70 = 0.00 and pLDDT 95-97 are exactly the compact helical amphipaths where an accessibility statement is both computable and load-bearing. A gate that reports on 8 of 22 and refuses 14 is an honest gate, not a broken one.

Reviewers treated the unseeded single-sample problem as unaddressable without new compute. It is partly addressable for free: three sequences in the catalogue were folded twice under different candidate codes, giving unplanned replicates. Measured deltas are 0.09, 1.55 and 1.97 pLDDT units and 0.015, 0.061 and 0.024 pTM — and the largest spread is on the lowest-confidence pair, as expected. That is a real, zero-cost run-to-run variance estimate that should be reported before anyone spends GPU-hours on seed replication.
revised.final_method:
Two modules, shipped in three separate commits so the cheap exact work is not held hostage by the structural work.

COMMIT 1 — platform/cbc/compute/proteolysis.py, sequence arm only, no structure. (a) For each of the 23 unique standard-residue sequences, enumerate cleavage sites and complete-digest fragments with pyteomics 5.0.1 parser.expasy_rules / parser.cleave over a declared panel (trypsin, chymotrypsin high specificity, pepsin pH2.0, thermolysin, proteinase K, glutamyl endopeptidase), regex=True to silence the rule-interpretation warning. Every emitted value is labelled 'in vitro specificity rule match (Expasy <rule>, pyteomics 5.0.1)'. The provenance note states verbatim that expasy_rules contains no neprilysin, IDE, ACE or DPP-4 rule and that these are the activities governing CNS-compartment peptide exposure, so the census is not a clearance estimate. (b) Every site count is reported as a z-score against >=200 composition-matched shuffles of the same sequence (shared generator with AIML-BENCH-3, seeded and recorded), so composition-determined counts are visibly composition-determined. (c) Linker-cut fraction with its stated null: GGGGS contains no trypsin or chymotrypsin site, so the expected tryptic linker-cut fraction is exactly zero and any non-zero value is anomalous; report against that expectation, for the one candidate with non-zero gg_linker_fraction. (d) Released-fragment identity for the two KLVFF-bearing candidates: emit the full fragment list per protease with exact substring cross-reference to the motif_provenance KLVFFAEDVGSNKGAIIGLM entry, and report the computed result — no protease in the panel releases the intact core; trypsin releases LVFFAEDVGSNK, Glu-C releases KLVFFAE. Label it a predicted fragment identity under complete digestion by the named rule, never an in vivo claim. (e) Terminal audit: N1, P2, C-terminal residue, DPP-4 P2 motif boolean, declared amidation/acetylation — deterministic, four fields, no model.

COMMIT 2 — coordinate persistence, taken from STRUCTBIO-IDEA-1 step 6 / META-1 step 2 and NOT reimplemented here. Copy the 22 /tmp/cbc_boltz trees into data/structures/<code>/, record sha256 of each mmCIF, and write the path into every row of data/real_vs_hardcoded.json. Also record the three duplicate-sequence replicate pairs and their measured pLDDT/pTM deltas as the platform's first empirical run-to-run variance figure.

COMMIT 3 — structural overlay, conditional, with the refusal rule pre-declared before it runs. For a given candidate: if no persisted model exists, or if frac_below_70 >= 0.50, emit NO SASA and NO secondary-structure label for any site in that candidate — a refusal record naming the violating property, not a value with a caveat. On the pre-registered current data that refuses 13 unfolded candidates outright and 14 of the 22 folded ones, leaving 8. Where the gate passes, do not emit per-residue labels; emit the Hubbard quantity — the list of contiguous segments of length >=10 that are simultaneously solvent-exposed (relative SASA above a stated cutoff, biotite 1.7.1) and non-helical/non-sheet (biotite annotate_sse) — and report each cleavage site only as inside or outside such a segment. Where the same sequence has two independent folds, report the segment call from both and flag disagreement. No t1/2 anywhere.
final_success_criteria: A test asserts the module cannot emit a half-life: no field, no string, no unit of time appears in any output path. Checkable by grep over the module's emitted schema plus a unit test that fails if a time-dimensioned key is ever added.

Every site count carries a z-score against >=200 seeded composition-matched shuffles, and the seed and generator version are in provenance. A count reported without its null fails the validate.py gate.

Fragment identity for the two KLVFF candidates is emitted as a fragment list per protease with exact substring cross-reference to motif_provenance, and the record states explicitly that no protease in the panel releases intact Abeta16-35 — reproducible by an independent reader running parser.cleave() on the two sequences.

No output field anywhere in the module is named or labelled 'stability', 'half-life' or 'clearance'; every value reads 'in vitro specificity rule match' with the Expasy rule name and pyteomics version, and the provenance note names the four missing CNS peptidases.
data/structures/<code>/ contains all 22 mmCIF files with recorded sha256, every structural value's source_id resolves to a real path, and no structural value has a source_id pointing into /tmp.

The structural overlay refuses for every candidate with no model or frac_below_70 >= 0.50. Pre-registered prediction, checkable on delivery: 13 refused for no model, 14 of 22 refused for confidence, 8 reported. If the delivered numbers differ, the gate was changed after seeing the data.
Where the gate passes, output is a list of contiguous >=10-residue exposed-non-regular segments, not per-residue SASA labels, and each cleavage site is reported only as inside/outside one.
The three duplicate-sequence fold pairs are reported with their pLDDT and pTM deltas (measured: 0.09/1.55/1.97 and 0.015/0.061/0.024) as the platform's first run-to-run variance estimate.
All counts are reported over 23 unique standard-residue sequences, with the 35-to-26-to-23 reduction stated.
Environment is recorded: .venv312, Python 3.12.14, pyteomics 5.0.1, biotite 1.7.1, all pinned in a lockfile committed with the module. python3 verify_all.py stays green.

revised.title: Amphipathicity as a z-score against a composition-matched null, gated on measured model helicity — and a refusal-based verdict on the BBB
revised.changed_what: Three changes, one conceded outright, one adopted from the critics, one where the critics' measurement was wrong and mine contradicts theirs. CONCEDED: the environment claim. modlAMP was absent from both venvs when reviewers checked, so every number I quoted was unauditable from repo state. I installed it into .venv312 today (pip modlamp 4.3.2, whose __version__ attribute reports 4.3.0 — a genuine pinning trap, both strings must be recorded) and re-ran the panel. The control values reproduce exactly: melittin 0.5578, magainin-2 0.5092, LL-37 0.8966, insulin B-chain 0.1600. The numbers were right; the provenance was not, which in this repo is the same as being wrong. ADOPTED: four reviewers said the max-over-18-residue-window moment is length-biased and needs a per-molecule composition-matched null instead of a four-peptide eyeball comparison. They are right and I have implemented it — 200 seeded shuffles per sequence, 23 unique sequences. It changes the answer materially: on raw moment, 17 of 31 exceed 0.40 and six sit at 0.886-0.894, a mush; on z-score, four sequences separate cleanly at z = 4.79, 4.00, 3.83, 3.66 and the fifth-ranked is 1.16. The trigger becomes four molecules, not seventeen. DEFENDED WITH DATA: the medicinal chemist argued the correction inverts my headline — that CogDual-TrkB-PAS-10, the 100-mer, would become 'the LEAST amphipathic of the high scorers' once length bias is removed. I ran it. It does not invert; it strengthens. Composition-matched shuffles of that exact sequence give mean 0.482 with sd 0.086, so its raw 0.894 is z = 4.79, the HIGHEST in the catalogue. He used generic length-matched nulls; per-molecule composition-matched shuffles of a 100-mer have a tighter spread, and the tighter sd more than offsets the higher mean. The 100-mer remains the flagged false negative. ALSO DEFENDED WITH DATA: four reviewers argued the helicity gate is unusable because most models are low-confidence. In aggregate they are right — median plddt_mean is 60.97 and 14 of 22 have frac_below_70 >= 0.5 — but the aggregate is the wrong statistic here, and I checked the specific molecules. The three highest-moment folded candidates are the three highest-confidence models in the entire set: HippoAChE-AlkaPept-X2 and BasalAChE-GorgeBlock-B1 (same 36-mer) are 92% helix at pLDDT 95.17 and 95.26, and MicroAutophagy-Tag-M4 is 91% helix at pLDDT 96.83. For the molecules the moment is being used to flag, the helix assumption is not an assumption — it is a high-confidence structural observation, independently reproduced across two runs of the same sequence with identical SSE strings. The gate works precisely where it must. Where it does not, I refuse: HippoDual-TrkB-AMPK-X5 (z=4.00) is 58% helix at pLDDT 71.89 with the helix confined to residues 14-32, so its moment is reported only if the argmax window lies inside that segment; and CogDual-TrkB-PAS-10 has no model at all, so its flag is sequence-only until it is folded — the structural biologist was right to insist on that. FINALLY: I accept that the HemoPI2 two-control gate is self-validation on training-set members and I have made it unfixable-by-fudging — the module is now incapable of printing an HC50 in concentration units, mirroring the no-t1/2 rule. And I have adopted the decisive test the DMPK reviewer proposed, which is now cheap: HemoPI2 is trained on 1926 peptides with experimentally determined HC50 (Rathore 2025), so that set supplies the measured-HC50 reference the panel demanded. Using it to validate HemoPI2 would be circular; using it to test whether the Eisenberg moment predicts measured HC50 is not, because modlAMP's descriptor is independent of it. If Spearman rho between max-window moment and measured log HC50 has a CI including zero, mu_H is not used as a trigger at all and that negative is published.
conceded: modlAMP was not installed in either named venv; my 'verified installed this session' claim did not reproduce from repo state. Now installed in .venv312 with both the pip version (4.3.2) and the __version__ string (4.3.0) recorded, because they differ.
The raw max-over-window moment is length-biased and a four-peptide panel is not a calibration. Replaced by a per-molecule composition-matched z-score as the primary trigger.

LL-37 (0.897) scores above melittin (0.558) while melittin is far more hemolytic, so mu_H is demonstrably non-monotone in the endpoint. It cannot be a potency estimate; it is a facial-segregation descriptor and is now labelled as one.
Insulin B-chain is a weak negative control — surface-active and amyloidogenic, not a therapeutic-peptide comparator.
The HemoPI2 melittin/insulin gate is a two-point check on training-set members and establishes nothing about held-out performance.
Six candidates at 0.886-0.894 is four distinct sequences; three of the six are the identical 36-mer. Report over 23 unique standard-residue sequences.
CogDual-TrkB-PAS-10 is not among the 22 folded models, so no structural statement about it can be made until it is folded.
The composition rule should not be retired silently; it must be retired against a published confusion matrix.
Reporting mu_H alone ranks in one dimension when the classical reading is the mean-hydrophobicity / moment plane.
defended: The critic's specific inversion claim is wrong and I measured it: with per-molecule composition-matched shuffles, CogDual-TrkB-PAS-10 has z = 4.79, the highest in the catalogue, not the lowest of the high scorers. Generic length-matched nulls give the tighter sd away.

The 'helicity gate is unusable' objection does not survive checking which molecules it applies to. The three highest-moment folded candidates are the three most confident models in the set (91-92% helix, pLDDT 95-97, biotite annotate_sse, run today). The gate is refused for low-confidence candidates and honoured for high-confidence ones, which is what a gate is for.

The four-peptide control panel stays as an orientation aid alongside the z-score, and the melittin 0.5578 +/- 0.001 tripwire stays — extended, as one reviewer suggested, to pin both modlAMP version strings, since a silent scale change would otherwise move every candidate while leaving the tripwire satisfiable.

The BBB half needs no change and every reviewer agreed. Both its numbers are re-verified today: 4 of 35 candidates fall inside B3Pred's stated 5-30-residue domain, and 0 of 35 contain any of Angiopep-2, T7/HAIYPRH, RVG29, TAT, ApoE(159-167), CRT or THR as an exact substring. One reviewer said a catalogue-wide 'absent' belongs in the README rather than as 35 per-candidate fields; I keep the per-candidate refusal record because validate.py operates per candidate and a global note is not machine-checkable, but I agree the README needs the one-line design finding and will write it there too.
revised.final_method: platform/cbc/compute/membrane.py plus a demotion in peptide.py. (1) Environment first: .venv312 (Python 3.12.14), modlamp pinned by both pip version 4.3.2 and __version__ 4.3.0, lockfile committed. Install check is the four-peptide control panel recomputed at runtime; melittin must return 0.5578 +/- 0.001 or the module refuses to report anything. (2) Primary trigger: Eisenberg max-window moment (window=18, angle=100, modality='max') expressed as a z-score and percentile against >=200 seeded composition-matched shuffles of the same residue multiset, seed recorded. Raw value, null mean, null sd, z and percentile all emitted; the raw value is never the trigger. Also emit total sequence length residing in windows above a stated moment, which is not length-biased the same way, and the mean-hydrophobicity / moment plane position with the four controls in the same plane. (3) Helicity gate, three explicit states, never a silent default: 'helical in model (helix fraction X over the argmax window, mean local pLDDT Y)'; 'not helical in model'; 'no model, or frac_below_70 >= 0.50'. On current data state 1 applies to 3 sequences, state 2 or a windowed check to HippoDual-TrkB-AMPK-X5, and state 3 to the rest including CogDual-TrkB-PAS-10. Report both the gated and ungated moment so a reader sees how much the structural assumption moves the answer. (4) Decisive calibration, and the gate on everything downstream: retrieve the 1926-peptide measured-HC50 set underlying HemoPI2 (Rathore 2025, Commun Biol 8:176), compute the max-window moment for all of them with the identical modlAMP call, and report Spearman rho between moment and measured log HC50 with a bootstrap CI, plus each candidate's moment percentile against that measured distribution and the empirical HC50 interquartile range in its percentile band with n. If the CI includes zero, mu_H is not used as a liability trigger anywhere and that negative result is published — a cheap, decisive outcome either way. (5) HemoPI2 itself: the module is structurally incapable of emitting an HC50 in concentration units, enforced by a test, until it is validated on a held-out subset disjoint from its training set with the measured accuracy recorded in the provenance of every value it emits. If no disjoint set can be assembled, it emits classification only, labelled PREDICTED-UNVALIDATED, or nothing. Applicability-domain refusal on length against the training distribution, with the 100-mer and 62-mer predicted to be refused. (6) BBB: B3Pred's stated 5-30-residue domain as a hard gate with a per-candidate refusal record naming the violating length, plus a deterministic RMT shuttle-motif substring census over a versioned table where each entry carries its own DOI. Both results also written to the README as a design finding. (7) peptide.py: frac_cationic/frac_aromatic is demoted to a descriptor explicitly labelled composition-determined and order-invariant, retained and reported side by side with the z-score, and the change is published as a confusion matrix of old rule versus new trigger across the 23 sequences.
final_success_criteria: A test asserts the module cannot emit an HC50, or any hemolytic concentration in concentration units, until a held-out validation accuracy is recorded in provenance — the no-t1/2 pattern from IDEA-2, applied here.
Every moment is emitted with raw value, null mean, null sd, z, percentile, shuffle count and seed. A raw moment reported without its null fails validate.py.

Runtime control panel reproduces melittin 0.5578 +/- 0.001, magainin-2 0.5092, LL-37 0.8966, insulin B-chain 0.1600, and the assertion pins both modlAMP version strings (pip 4.3.2 and __version__ 4.3.0). Any drift refuses the whole module.

Pre-registered z-score result, checkable on delivery against today's seeded run: exactly four of 23 unique sequences exceed z = 3 (CogDual-TrkB-PAS-10 4.79, HippoDual-TrkB-AMPK-X5 4.00, MicroAutophagy-Tag-M4 3.83, HippoAChE-AlkaPept-X2 3.66) and the next-ranked is 1.16. A different set means the null or the seed changed after seeing the data.

Helicity is reported in one of three explicit states and never defaults. Pre-registered: HippoAChE-AlkaPept-X2, BasalAChE-GorgeBlock-B1 and MicroAutophagy-Tag-M4 report helical at 0.91-0.92 helix fraction and pLDDT 95.17/95.26/96.83; CogDual-TrkB-PAS-10 reports 'no model' and carries no structural claim until folded.

Spearman rho between max-window moment and measured log HC50 over the 1926-peptide reference set is reported with a bootstrap CI in the provenance of every moment value. If the CI includes zero, no liability trigger anywhere in the platform uses mu_H, and the README states that.

BBB section reports 4 of 35 inside B3Pred's cited 5-30-residue domain and 0 of 35 carrying any listed RMT shuttle motif, with per-candidate refusal records naming the violating length and each shuttle entry carrying its own DOI; the same two numbers appear in the README as a design finding.
A confusion matrix of frac_cationic/frac_aromatic versus the new z-score trigger across all 23 sequences is committed, so the descriptor change is auditable rather than asserted.

A regression test shows CogDual-TrkB-PAS-10 is flagged by the sequence-level trigger where it previously was not, and separately asserts that no structural property is attached to it while it has no persisted model.
python3 verify_all.py stays green; environment and lockfile committed.

refined.expert: Metascience / research software engineering (reproducibility, reporting standards); JOSS reviewer

revised.title: Rescue, track, pin, seed: artifact preservation and a measured reproducibility envelope for the Boltz-2 results
revised.changed_what: Reordered so the two irreversible-loss items (artifact rescue from /tmp, git tracking + LICENSE) run first and everything else follows. Corrected a false premise in my own write-up. Replaced the '2x envelope' heuristic and the byte-identity criterion, both of which critics correctly demolished. Scaled the seed study from n=3-on-one-candidate to n>=10 on 4 candidates stratified by computed pLDDT. Absorbed the surviving 20% of the withdrawn META-2 (LICENSE, ChEMBL CC-BY-SA inheritance, CITATION.cff, typed NOT_COMPUTED reasons). Added a new requirement that no critic anticipated and that I discovered by accident while running the seed pilot this session: full-dependency-closure hashing, because the Boltz environment silently changed underneath me mid-experiment.
conceded: My claim 'no mmCIF, confidence JSON, PAE array or weights checksum was retained anywhere in the repository (searched: no Boltz output directory exists)' was FALSE. I scoped the search to the repository and reported the result as if it were global. Four critics found the outputs; I confirmed them: 22 complete boltz_results trees at /tmp/cbc_boltz, each with input.yaml, input_model_0.cif, confidence_input_model_0.json, and pae/pde/plddt .npz, timestamped Aug 17 02:54-03:06. Total 1.8 MB. This is the exact class of error the proposal is about — an assertion stated with more confidence than its evidence supported — committed inside the proposal to fix it. Rescue is now item 0, and the archaeology I claimed was impossible is a five-minute copy.

The '2x the seed envelope' reclassification rule is wrong and I withdraw it. Four critics independently objected and each was right for a different reason: an sd from n=3 carries ~50% relative uncertainty, the factor 2 is arbitrary where an interval belongs, and seed variance is sequence-dependent so one envelope cannot govern 22 heterogeneous deltas. Replaced with a per-candidate interval test and an explicit three-way outcome.

The success criterion 'two same-seed runs are byte-identical' cannot be met on MPS and offering it as the good outcome was sloppy. Metal reduction ordering is non-deterministic and seeding controls the noise draw, not the summation order. Replaced with a measured-divergence criterion. I could not even test it this session — the same-seed repeat run crashed (see below).

Importing the 0.133 ipTM sd as the pLDDT envelope would over-retract. ipTM on a two-chain complex is an interface metric with bimodal docked/undocked character; mean pLDDT is an average over 26-47 residues. Different quantities, different variance. Measure each separately.

accelerator: 'gpu' appears in all 22 rows of data/real_vs_hardcoded.json and is misleading to a reader reconstructing the environment. I adopt the fix: env.runtime() must record the resolved torch device and backend alongside the CLI string.

Item 5 (git + LICENSE) being last in my method while being the precondition for every other proposal's success criteria was a sequencing error. Confirmed today: git ls-files returns 0 for platform/, data/, memory/, research/, reviews/, and there is no LICENSE. A cloner receives only the discredited mockup.
The seed and configuration passthrough in structure.py is the same change AIML-STRUCT-3 specifies. It should be implemented once. I cede implementation ownership and will consume it.

Four ARTIFACT hash mismatches reproduce exactly as reported (ok=10, mismatch=4, missing=0: data/dataset.json, data/real_vs_hardcoded.json, platform/validate.py, reviews/REVIEW_REPORT.md). The ledger asserts an integrity it does not check.
defended: The headline result is not at risk to the degree two critics implied, and I now have a measurement rather than an argument. I ran the seed pilot this session on HippoAChE-AlkaPept-X2 (36 aa, msa=empty, diffusion_samples=1, recycling_steps=3, accelerator gpu): seed 1 gave complex_plddt 95.0823, seed 2 gave 95.2223. Across-seed |delta| = 0.14 pLDDT units. The smallest genuine overstatement in the dataset is -10.81, i.e. 77x that envelope; 14 of 22 deltas exceed 30 units. The three near-zero rows (+0.37, +0.96, +3.43) are already reported as agreement, not as overstatement, and the file's own interpretation text already says agreement on a trivially-confident amphipathic helix is not vindication. So the claim genuinely in question is at most 2 of the 19 (PfcTrk-ErkEnhancer-P2 at -10.81, AstroEaat2-Up-A2 at -11.08), not 19 of 19. I still run the full study, because 0.14 units in the high-confidence regime says nothing about the low-confidence regime — but the burden of proof has moved.

The accelerator:'gpu' string is not a fabricated value of the same kind as the RDKit literal, and calling it 'a hand-set provenance string that is wrong in the shipped data' overstates it. `boltz predict --help` accepts only [gpu|cpu|tpu]; 'gpu' is the argument that was actually passed and it is recorded faithfully. The defect is that Lightning's vocabulary is not the hardware's, so the record is ambiguous rather than false. It still needs fixing — but the distinction matters, because the remedy differs: the RDKit literal needs deleting, the accelerator string needs supplementing.

Refusing to containerise the Boltz layer stands. Docker Desktop on macOS has no Metal passthrough; an image would silently fall back to CPU and produce different wall times and different coordinates while claiming to be the reproducible artifact. Recording the limitation beats shipping a misleading image.
revised.final_method:
0. TODAY, before anything else, in this order. (a) Copy /tmp/cbc_boltz into runs/2026-08-17-legacy-batch/ (1.8 MB, verified), sha256 every file, write one ARTIFACT ledger record per run, and add an `artifact_path` + `artifact_sha256` field to all 22 rows of data/real_vs_hardcoded.json. macOS purges /tmp; these files are the only physical evidence of what produced the published numbers and re-folding cannot recover their provenance. (b) git add platform/ data/ memory/ research/ reviews/ verify_all.py; add an OSI LICENSE for code, a separate data licence stating ChEMBL's CC-BY-SA inheritance explicitly for data/corpus_ACHE.json, and CITATION.cff. (c) Re-run the ARTIFACT re-hash, resolve the four mismatches by re-recording, and wire the loop into verify_all.py permanently.

1. platform/cbc/env.py::runtime(), introspection only, now with full dependency closure. Returns rdkit.__version__, sys.version, platform.machine()/mac_ver(), torch.__version__, torch.backends.mps.is_available(), the RESOLVED torch device for the run (not the CLI accelerator string), boltz version via the .venv312 interpreter, sha256 of the ~/.boltz weight files, AND a sha256 over the sorted `pip freeze` output of each venv. Delete the literal at build_dataset.py:34 and the dead getattr at corpus.py:318 (verified: hasattr(chem,'RDKIT_VERSION') is False, so the fallback is always taken). verify_all.py gains a check that every provenance.software string, every accelerator string and every seed in the emitted dataset traces to a runtime() call rather than a literal.

The dependency-closure hash is not defensive over-engineering; it is a response to something that happened to me while running the pilot for this revision. Two folds completed normally (28.3 s, 26.7 s). The third crashed: `ImportError: Numba needs NumPy 2.1 or less. Got NumPy 2.5.` A concurrent process replaced numpy in the shared .venv312 at 13:00:50 today, mid-experiment. The 22 legacy runs were produced at 02:58 under the previous numpy; that environment no longer exists on this machine ten hours later, and nothing in the recorded provenance (`version: "2.2.1", licence: "MIT"`) can distinguish the two. Here the drift announced itself with an ImportError. Had numpy 2.5 been import-compatible but numerically different, the same drift would have silently produced different coordinates under an identical provenance string. Pinning is therefore not hygiene, it is the difference between a measurement and an anecdote. Note also what I did NOT do: I did not pip-install a repair into the shared venv, because mutating an environment another process is using is precisely the harm I had just observed.

2. Seeded re-fold, sized to answer the question. Pass --seed (recorded), --recycling_steps, --diffusion_samples on every invocation; persist mmCIF + confidence JSON + PAE npz under runs/<content-hash>/ with ARTIFACT records; stop discarding samples beyond sorted(cifs)[0]. Then: 4 candidates stratified by computed pLDDT (one each from the ~95, ~85, ~60, ~50 bands), 10 seeds each, one arm held at diffusion_samples=1 to match the legacy configuration so the envelope is comparable to the deltas it judges. 40 runs at the measured ~27 s is ~18 minutes of MPS. There is no compute argument for extrapolating from one candidate and I should not have proposed it. Report the across-seed sd for pLDDT with a CI on the sd, as a function of mean pLDDT so the sequence-dependence is visible. Same-seed repeats (>=3 per candidate) give a measured divergence in max per-atom RMSD and |delta pLDDT|; that measurement becomes the declared tolerance, and MPS non-determinism is recorded as a documented property, never as a determinism claim.

3. Reclassification by interval, not by heuristic. For each of the 22 legacy deltas, emit one of exactly three labels: `exceeds_sampling_noise` (legacy value outside the across-seed range for that candidate's confidence band), `inside_sampling_noise` (legacy value inside it), `untested` (that band not re-folded). The three-way label with its n replaces both the 'overstated' prose and my discarded 2x rule.

4. platform/reproduce.py. Rebuild dataset.json from data/extracted_raw.json + data/curated.json into a temp dir; classify every numeric leaf as identical | within_declared_tolerance | differs | absent; exit non-zero on any `differs` lacking a declared tolerance and a stated reason. Tolerances are declared per quantity with a physical justification BEFORE the first comparison (RDKit cLogP is exact-by-algorithm; Boltz pLDDT is not). reproduce.py refuses to compare across two runs whose dependency-closure hashes differ, and says so, rather than reporting a spurious diff.

5. Pinning and CI, honestly scoped. requirements.lock with hashes for the 3.14 env and requirements-boltz.lock for the 3.12 env, recording why they are separate (boltz pins a scipy with no cp314 wheel). Repair .venv312 from the lockfile, not from `pip install -U`. Containerise only the deterministic CPU layer (linux/arm64: chem/peptide/thermo/validate/build_dataset). GitHub Actions runs the CPU tier on every push; the MPS tier is reported as a locally-run tier with its manifest, never silently skipped.
final_success_criteria: runs/2026-08-17-legacy-batch/ exists in git with 22 run directories, every file hashed into an ARTIFACT ledger record, and all 22 rows of data/real_vs_hardcoded.json carrying artifact_path + artifact_sha256 that re-verify. Checkable by: re-hash loop reports 0 mismatches over the batch.

`git ls-files platform/ data/ memory/ | wc -l` is non-zero; LICENSE and a data licence exist; the ChEMBL CC-BY-SA inheritance is stated in data/corpus_ACHE.json and in the data licence; CITATION.cff parses with cffconvert.
Ledger ARTIFACT re-hash reports 0 mismatches (from today's 4); appending one byte to data/dataset.json makes verify_all.py exit non-zero.

`grep -rn 'RDKit 20' platform/` returns no hit inside provenance construction; installing a different RDKit in a scratch venv makes verify_all.py exit non-zero; no accelerator string in the emitted dataset is a literal, and each row carries the resolved torch device.
Every emitted run record carries seed, diffusion_samples, recycling_steps, boltz_version, weights_sha256, deps_closure_sha256, and a path to retained mmCIF + confidence JSON.

A seed table with n>=10 seeds on 4 candidates spanning the pLDDT range, reporting across-seed sd with a CI on the sd for pLDDT, plus a measured same-seed divergence (max per-atom RMSD and |delta pLDDT|) that becomes the declared tolerance. Pre-registered prediction, from this session's n=2 pilot: the high-confidence-band envelope will be under 1 pLDDT unit. If it is not, I am wrong and the reclassification changes.
All 22 legacy deltas carry exactly one of exceeds_sampling_noise | inside_sampling_noise | untested, with the n behind each label stated.

platform/reproduce.py exits 0 on a clean checkout; data/reproduction_report.json classifies 100% of numeric leaves; every `differs` leaf carries a tolerance declared before the comparison plus a reason. reproduce.py refuses (exit non-zero, explicit message) when dependency-closure hashes differ between the recorded and current environment — verifiable today by pointing it at the pre-13:00 and post-13:00 .venv312 states.
CI runs the CPU tier on every push and the report names the MPS tier as locally-run with its manifest attached, rather than omitting it.

revised.title: FAIR release: PROV-O/RO-Crate export, resolvable identifiers, DOI, preprint (WITHDRAWN)
revised.changed_what: Withdrawn as a workstream. Its two load-bearing pieces — the licences (code, and ChEMBL CC-BY-SA inheritance for data/corpus_ACHE.json) and CITATION.cff — move into META-1 item 0, where they belong anyway since they ship with the first commit. Everything else is deferred without a date.
conceded: The decisive objection is the one I cannot answer: provenance is not validity, and a FAIR-badged, DOI-bearing, standards-validating artifact over numbers whose accuracy is still unmeasured makes those numbers MORE likely to be reused uncritically, not less. A machine-traversable chain from a pLDDT to its inputs says nothing about whether that pLDDT means anything. For a project whose entire remediation is about not lending unearned authority to numbers, shipping a citable wrapper before shipping a measurement would be the same sin in better clothes. That is a sufficient reason to withdraw, independent of sequencing.

A crate describing a working tree that is not in version control, has no licence, and whose own ledger fails its hash check on four artifacts would convert an internal inconsistency into a citable external claim. Serialization is not provenance.
Minting a Zenodo DOI is irreversible and would permanently attach a version identifier to a state the author will want to disown.

The preprint plan was the worst item. Its proposed headline claims were '19 of 22 pLDDT values overstated by up to 46 units' and 'ipTM identically 0.00' — the first is precisely what META-1 exists to test against a measured envelope, and the second is a definitional artifact of folding lone chains, not a finding about the legacy data. Publishing corrections that are themselves wrong, in a citable venue, is the single worst outcome available to this project. I withdraw the preprint.
HTTP HEAD 200 from a resolver is not evidence a record exists; resolvers routinely return 200 for well-formed but non-existent accessions. My IRI-resolution success criterion was unsound.
A network call in a build gate gets disabled after its second false alarm. ChEMBL returned HTTP 500 to me again this session. Per-commit checks must be offline and syntactic.
JOSS is blocked on META-1 regardless, and I said so myself; a proposal whose deliverables all sit behind another proposal should not be a parallel workstream.
defended: One idea in it was genuinely novel and I want it on the record so it is not lost: this project's distinguishing content is its ABSENCES — 35 candidates with typed NOT_COMPUTED reasons, and retracted claims preserved verbatim. An ordinary tabular export renders a deliberate refusal indistinguishable from a missing measurement, and prov:wasInvalidatedBy is the correct predicate for the retractions. That modelling insight survives the withdrawal. It should be revisited only after at least one accuracy figure with an interval exists, so that what gets packaged is a measurement and not merely a lineage. I am not putting a date on it.
revised.final_method: Withdrawn. Re-homed to META-1 item 0: OSI LICENSE for code; a data licence stating ChEMBL's CC-BY-SA inheritance explicitly for data/corpus_ACHE.json; CITATION.cff. Deferred indefinitely, with a stated precondition rather than a schedule: no RO-Crate, no PROV-O export, no DOI and no preprint until (a) reproduce.py exits 0 on a clean checkout, (b) the ledger re-hash reports zero mismatches, and (c) at least one accuracy claim carries a measured interval. If those three land, the export is a few days of mechanical mapping and can be reproposed then.
final_success_criteria: The two re-homed items are verifiable in META-1: a LICENSE exists, the ChEMBL CC-BY-SA inheritance is stated in data/corpus_ACHE.json, and CITATION.cff parses with cffconvert.
No ro-crate-metadata.json, no PROV-O export, no Zenodo DOI and no preprint is produced under this workstream. Withdrawal is checkable by their absence.

revised.title: Criterion-exercise audit with mandatory trip-fixtures, plus a numerically-bound pre-specification for the AChE affinity benchmark
revised.changed_what: Split into two parts with different dependencies, because the panel was unanimous that the audit is valuable on its own and needs none of the freeze machinery. Rebuilt the audit around evaluation counters and a mandatory trip-fixture per criterion, replacing my zero-count-over-N heuristic which produced false positives. Filled the pre-specification's blank thresholds with a formula tied to measured noise, added an INCONCLUSIVE outcome and a frozen power statement, added the receptor construct and a pose-validity stratum, and stopped calling a self-controlled ledger 'pre-registration'.
conceded: My zero-rejection rule is unsound and would get the check suppressed. It conflates 'the criterion was never evaluated because its field was always null' (the actual bug) with 'the criterion was evaluated 258 times and legitimately rejected nobody' (normal, e.g. max_mol_weight=2000 against small molecules, which the current denominator shows as too_large: 0). Redefined with two counters plus a demonstration requirement.

The mandatory trip-fixture — every criterion must ship a synthetic record engineered to trip it, and the gate fails if the criterion does not reject that fixture — is a better mechanism than any count rule and I adopt it. It catches decorative criteria without punishing criteria that correctly reject nothing on real data, and it would have caught the confidence_score bug the moment the criterion was written.

A decision rule reading 'MAE below X and rho above Y' with X and Y unfilled is not a pre-specification; the thresholds ARE the pre-specification, and filling them after the pilot is exactly the degree of freedom the mechanism exists to close. Six critics said this. Bound numerically below.

At n=18 the 95% CI on Spearman rho is roughly +/-0.45 and a bootstrap CI on MAE will be wide enough that almost any threshold passes or fails trivially. Publishing that as a verdict on Boltz-2 would be a claim about statistical power dressed as a claim about the model. Added a mandatory frozen power section and a third outcome.

Huperzine A and its 2.41 log error are already in the ledger, so affinity-ache-v1 cannot be pre-specified for that compound in any epistemically meaningful sense. Declared as the motivating pilot observation and excluded from the primary analysis.

The receptor construct is a free parameter I left unpinned while pinning the compounds. Mature chain vs full-length, monomer vs dimer, gorge conformation, MSA mode, seed, recycling steps, diffusion samples, top-1-vs-mean selection — each can move a predicted affinity by more than the effect being measured. A protocol that freezes the ligands and not the receptor is not frozen. Added to the required fields.

A ledger the same agent controls is not a registry, and 'hash-locked pre-specification' overstated what it guarantees. Nothing in my design prevented freezing several protocols and reporting the one that came out well.

Raising min_assay_confidence from 8 to 9 shrinks the corpus without removing the real confound: ChEMBL confidence distinguishes direct from homologous single-protein assignment, not recombinant human AChE from eel or bovine erythrocyte enzyme mapped to CHEMBL220, and the latter dominates the log-scale scatter. Demoted confidence to a secondary filter; promoted an executable assay-provenance criterion to primary.

The denominator is a for-loop bound presented as a population. Confirmed in source: iter_target_activities (corpus.py:190) caps at limit=1000/page=200, target_activity_count (corpus.py:182) fetches the true total and is defined but never called anywhere in platform/ or verify_all.py. So 'activities_examined: 300 / 258 distinct molecules' is a client-side truncation artifact — and it is the platform's advertised methodological centrepiece. This is a decorative criterion of exactly the class the audit exists to detect, sitting inside the audit's own showcase.

ChEMBL availability is a real operational problem, not a caveat: it returned HTTP 500 to me again this session. A monitor that cannot distinguish 'nothing changed' from 'the server was down' is not a monitor.
Three panel proposals are commissioning overlapping AChE affinity batches. Freezing one protocol only helps if it is the one the others run.
defended: min_assay_confidence should be fixed and demoted to a secondary criterion, not deleted. Once the /assay join works it is cheap, it does real work at the margin, and — more importantly — it becomes the trip-fixture case study: the criterion that was advertised for months while never evaluating a single record is the audit's motivating example and should remain in the protocol as a live, exercised criterion rather than being quietly removed.

My reading of ChEMBL confidence semantics was correct and I keep it: /assay/CHEMBL636834 returns confidence_score 8 with confidence_description 'Homologous single protein target assigned'; direct assignment is 9. The corpus prose claiming 'directly assigned to a single protein' at threshold 8 overstates what 8 denotes, independently of whether 9 is the right filter to use.

The criterion-exercise audit ships independently of the freeze machinery. It needs no protocol format, no PRESPEC record and no benchmark, and holding it hostage to the pre-registration debate would delay the batch's most generalisable contribution.
revised.final_method:
PART A — the criterion-exercise audit (ships alone, no dependencies beyond META-1 item 0).
Every declared criterion is instrumented with two counters: `evaluated` (the field it claims to read was present and non-null on this record) and `rejected`. Three outcomes, only the first fatal. NOT_EXERCISED: evaluated == 0 — a wiring bug; fail the gate with a message naming the field AND the endpoint it claimed to read. NON_BINDING: evaluated > 0 and rejected == 0 — informational, and the protocol must declare in advance whether that is expected. OVER_FIRING: rejected/evaluated > 0.95 over a large denominator — also flagged, because tier_excluded rejecting 240 of 258 is arithmetically active while doing the work of a pharmacology filter via ChEMBL's natural_product flag, which this repository already documents as labelling donepezil and metoclopramide natural products. Every criterion's counts are a required output field, so a criterion rejecting 1 of 258 is as visible as one rejecting none. Independently of counts, every criterion must ship a unit-test fixture — a synthetic record engineered to trip it — and the gate fails if the criterion does not reject its own fixture. Applied today this fails immediately and correctly on min_assay_confidence. Also audited: the denominator itself must record its retrieval bounds and call target_activity_count, so a truncation cap can never again be reported as a population.

PART B — the pre-specification (hard-depends on META-1 item 0; the freeze is not binding until the repository is in git and the ledger passes its own hash check).
1. protocols/<name>.yaml carrying: population and inclusion criteria, each naming the exact field and the exact endpoint it is read from; chembl_release, retrieval UTC timestamp, verbatim query URLs, and the true total_count; the RECEPTOR construct — accession, residue range, oligomeric state, glycosylation, MSA mode, seed, recycling steps, diffusion samples, top-1-vs-mean selection; replicate aggregation specified at the level that determines whether two records are replicates at all (enzyme source and species, substrate identity, [S] relative to Km, pre-incubation time); enantiomer handling; and the decision rule.
2. platform/prespec.py with freeze / run / verify against the append-only ledger, plus an enumerable registry in which every frozen protocol must reach a terminal recorded outcome — completed, or abandoned with a stated reason — so the denominator of attempts is visible. That is the checkable analogue of a trial registry and it closes the selective-reporting hole my original design left open. The frozen hash is pushed to a signed git tag on the remote; where no external anchor exists the protocol says in plain text that this is a self-discipline device with no third-party guarantee.
3. Decision rule, bound numerically before freezing and by formula rather than by preference: report Boltz-2 affinity as PREDICTED only if (i) the 95% CI upper bound on MAE is below 2 x sigma_exp for the endpoint class, with sigma_exp taken from the corpus's own replicate scatter after excluding carbamates and unmatched-[S] records, AND (ii) the paired bootstrap CI on the MAE difference versus the per-target-median null excludes zero. No threshold below the noise floor (unattainable by construction) and none above the null (unearned). A mandatory power section, computed and frozen before the run, states the minimum detectable difference at the planned n; if the MDE is uninformative the run returns INCONCLUSIVE — a third outcome distinct from 'reported' and 'refused' — so a power failure is never published as a verdict on the model. The contamination caveat is made operative rather than adjacent: Boltz-2's affinity head trained on ChEMBL, BindingDB, PDBbind and MF-PCBA, so ChEMBL membership is a lower bound on contamination, the measured MAE is an optimistic ceiling, failure at the ceiling is dispositive and success at the ceiling is uninformative. Pre-declared pose-validity stratum: predictions placing the ligand outside the gorge are reported separately and never averaged into the MAE.
4. Sequencing that makes the machinery real rather than theatrical: affinity-ache-v1 must be frozen BEFORE any re-scored huperzine A number is published. If the 2.41 -> 1.43 retraction ships first and is pre-registered afterwards, the mechanism is decoration. Huperzine A itself is declared as the motivating pilot observation and excluded from the primary analysis. One merged protocol and one overnight batch across the three overlapping panel proposals.
5. Availability policy: record HTTP status and record count per criterion on every scheduled run; batch the /assay join with retry-and-backoff and an on-disk cache; fail loudly on unreachable sources rather than emitting a diff.
final_success_criteria: PART A, independently checkable: the audit reports evaluated and rejected counts for every criterion; it flags min_assay_confidence as NOT_EXERCISED on the current corpus and passes it after the /assay join; every criterion has a trip-fixture and the gate fails when a criterion does not reject its own fixture (verify by deleting the confidence comparison and watching the gate fail); tier_excluded at 240/258 is flagged OVER_FIRING.

data/corpus_ACHE.json is re-emitted with chembl_release, retrieval UTC timestamp, verbatim query URLs, and both the true target_activity_count and the retrieval cap, so the denominator is a population and not a for-loop bound. Checkable: activities_examined is no longer equal to a hard-coded limit.

protocols/affinity-ache-v1.yaml contains no unfilled threshold. Checkable mechanically: a schema validation that rejects any placeholder in the decision rule, plus a frozen power section giving the MDE at the planned n.

A PRESPEC record exists with a UTC timestamp strictly earlier than every result record bearing that protocol hash, anchored to a signed git tag on the remote; editing the YAML after freezing makes `prespec run` exit non-zero.
The protocol registry is enumerable and every frozen protocol has a terminal outcome — completed or abandoned with a reason. Checkable: `prespec list` shows no protocol in limbo.

The benchmark reports MAE with bootstrap 95% CI, Spearman rho with CI, the per-compound table, the pose-validity stratum reported separately, and one of exactly three verdicts (PREDICTED / NOT_COMPUTED / INCONCLUSIVE-underpowered) assigned by the frozen formula — whichever way the numbers fall, and with huperzine A excluded from the primary analysis and named as the motivating observation.
No re-scored huperzine A figure is published before affinity-ache-v1 is frozen. Checkable from ledger timestamp ordering.

The scheduled re-run records HTTP status and per-criterion record counts, and on an unreachable source emits an explicit failure rather than a zero-drift or total-loss diff. Testable today, since ChEMBL is returning HTTP 500.

slate.title: Take custody of the evidence: version-control platform/ and data/, rescue the 22 Boltz runs out of /tmp, content-address every artefact, and make run_boltz pass --seed
slate.one_line: Nothing else on this slate is worth doing until the results already on this machine are under version control and addressable by hash.
slate.the_question_it_answers: Which bytes produced the numbers the platform is currently displaying? The platform cannot answer this at all today: `git ls-files platform data` returns zero, so every module, every dataset and every measured result in this rebuild is untracked, and the only copies of the 22 Boltz-2 predictions (1.8 MB, verified present at /tmp/cbc_boltz with input_model_0.cif, confidence JSON and pae/plddt npz) sit in a directory macOS is entitled to delete on reboot. data/real_vs_hardcoded.json has no path field, so no displayed pLDDT can be traced to a coordinate file.
slate.scientific_basis: Provenance is the project's stated non-negotiable, and provenance without custody is a claim about files that no longer exist. Six of the proposals on this slate pin success criteria to the /tmp trees; one proposal (AIML-STRUCT-1) had to write its own criterion as unsatisfiable because 'committed' is currently impossible. Separately, platform/cbc/compute/structure.py:191-195 builds the Boltz command list without --seed, while boltz/main.py:1102 guards seed_everything(seed) behind 'if seed is not None' with CLI default None: all 22 existing structures are therefore unseeded single draws, which is the root cause of the withdrawn 'trivalent sulfur' finding.
slate.method_summary: One day, no inference. (1) git add platform/ and data/ (the current .gitignore does not exclude them; they were simply never added) and commit, so the 215 checks and the 91-violation gate become auditable history rather than working-tree state. (2) Move /tmp/cbc_boltz to artifacts/boltz/<sha256-prefix>/, register each run in the memory ledger as an ARTIFACT record with sha256, and add mmcif_path + sha256 to every row of data/real_vs_hardcoded.json. (3) Add seed, use_msa_server, sampling_steps and step_scale as parameters of run_boltz and record the seed in the returned provenance dict; stamp the 22 legacy runs seed=null, unseeded. (4) Fix _collect_boltz_outputs (structure.py:220), which keeps only sorted(...)[0] and silently discards every model beyond the top-ranked one, making ensembles impossible. (5) Replace the hand-set accelerator string (recorded as 'gpu' in all 22 rows, which is wrong) with runtime introspection, and add a validate.py rule rejecting hand-set accelerator values.
slate.effort: 1 day, one engineer, zero inference, 1.8 MB of new repository content
success_criteria: `git ls-files platform data | wc -l` is greater than zero and includes every module named in the panel texts.
The 22 boltz_results trees resolve at a repo path; every row of data/real_vs_hardcoded.json carries mmcif_path and sha256, and every sha256 recomputes from the committed file.
run_boltz emits --seed and records it in provenance; a test asserts the 22 legacy rows are stamped seed=null rather than given a fabricated seed.
_collect_boltz_outputs returns all requested samples; a test folds one input at diffusion_samples=3 and asserts three models are returned.

The accelerator field is produced by torch-level introspection; a test asserts the recorded string matches the introspected device, and the incorrect legacy 'gpu' values are corrected or explicitly marked unverifiable.
slate.panel_score: not separately scored; extracted by the chair from STRUCTBIO-IDEA-1 Stage 0 (6 critiques, value 4.5 / rigour 3.83 / feasibility 5.0) and from AIML-STRUCT-1's own unsatisfiable-criterion admission
slate.consensus_note: Unanimous once stated. The structural biologist proposed it as Stage 0 of a larger study and confirmed the /tmp trees exist, correcting other panellists who had asserted no Boltz output existed at all. The ML-for-structural-biology proposer independently discovered the missing --seed and the wrong accelerator string. No one objected; the chair's only change is to promote it out of a parent proposal, because burying the custody of all measured evidence inside a disulfide study is how it gets deferred. Nobody dissented, but nobody had ranked it first either, which is itself the finding.

slate.title: Fix and measure the inference configuration: same-seed divergence, a two-level variance decomposition reported separately for pLDDT, ipTM and interface PAE, and MSA mode as a controlled factor
slate.one_line: Measure how much of every structural number is the sampler before interpreting any of it as biology.
slate.the_question_it_answers: How large is a difference in pLDDT or ipTM before it means anything? The platform cannot answer this. It has published 22 pLDDT values and a set of 10-46 unit legacy deltas without knowing the across-seed envelope of the quantity being compared, and one proposer already argued from a 3-seed ipTM sd of 0.133 to the interpretation of pLDDT deltas — two statistics with different distributions.
slate.scientific_basis: Repeatability is not accuracy, and neither is a property of a model in the abstract: both are properties of a configuration. ipTM on a two-chain complex is often bimodal (docked vs undocked) while mean pLDDT averages hundreds of residues, so the two cannot share a variance estimate. The relative standard error of an sd at n=3 is about 50%, so the pilot's 0.133 is compatible with anything from 0.07 to 0.20. The aten::linalg_svd MPS-to-CPU fallback in boltz/model/loss/diffusionv2.py is exactly the backend dispatch that breaks bitwise determinism, so byte-reproducibility must be measured rather than promised.
slate.method_summary: (0) One hour: run an identical job twice at the same seed; publish either 'bitwise identical' or the measured max per-atom deviation, |delta ipTM| and |delta pLDDT|, and adopt that number as the platform's reproducibility tolerance. (1) Pre-register the sample-selection rule in writing, timestamped, before any batch: top-1 of N by confidence_score, recorded in every output row, shared by every structural batch on this slate.
